nodes.label: Nubjuk Brain
nodes.rationale: RPi-hosted stateful STI service becomes active in Phase 4 and keeps both mock and real voice paths available for verification.

nodes.label: Locked /sti Protocol
nodes.rationale: External communication changes require user approval and simultaneous MCU changes.

nodes.label: Single-flight Concurrency Model
nodes.rationale: Only one active utterance is allowed; a second session_start receives session_busy immediately.

nodes.label: Audio Backpressure Queue
nodes.rationale: Receive-loop consumption is separated from audio buffering and ASR work so MCU bursts do not block WebSocket reads.

nodes.label: Frame Warning Policy
nodes.rationale: Frame anomalies are warnings during early hardware bring-up, with stricter schema_invalid behavior deferred until MCU framing is proven stable.

nodes.label: Brain-owned Motion Recipe Catalog
nodes.rationale: Brain owns natural-language recipe matching so aliases can expand without MCU firmware changes, but new motion ids still require MCU registry support.

nodes.label: SLM Catalog Agreement Safety Rule
nodes.rationale: A moving robot should prefer unknown over an unsupported motion; SLM output can only raise confidence when deterministic catalog matching agrees.

nodes.label: Phase 4 Latency Budget
nodes.rationale: Natural-language freedom is accepted as a latency trade-off versus Rhino-only recognition.

nodes.label: Systemd Deployment
nodes.rationale: Production uses direct systemd execution to avoid Docker overhead and thermal/cgroup side effects on RPi.

nodes.label: Phase 4 Entry Checklist
nodes.rationale: Brain work should not start from speculation; entry requires observed Rhino limits, corpus evidence, user decision, hardware, licensing, and thermal proof.

nodes.label: Strict Binary Validation Follow-up
nodes.rationale: Keep first hardware bring-up forgiving, then consider stricter frame errors once the MCU encoder is known to work.

nodes.label: Tail Partial Frame Decision
nodes.rationale: Current partial-frame tolerance helps diagnose MCU streaming, but production may need accept, pad, or reject semantics.
